target_customer: EV charging networks, automakers, fleets and charging apps that need roaming and Plug and Charge
problem: Drivers face fragmented charging networks with separate apps and payment; Emobi offers a single integration with automated authentication and payment, including on legacy chargers.
business_model: B2B infrastructure and API with enterprise partnerships (pricing not found)
product_category: EV charging roaming and Plug and Charge infrastructure

founders.name: Lin Sun Fa
founders.background_notes: From YC company page. Technical flag from the cybersecurity degree.

competitors.name: Monta
competitors.what: EV charge management and roaming platform

competitors.name: Bonnet
competitors.what: UK consumer app for paying at public chargers across networks
competitors.funding_then: about 920K GBP in August 2021 then about 4M GBP in March 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating many charger networks and protocols and implementing ISO 15118 style Plug and Charge on legacy hardware requires security and interoperability work.

defensibility.rationale: Network integrations and automaker pilots are slow to replicate, but the company reports two provisional patents only.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; no acquisition or copy found.

market_need_then: EV adoption was growing and charging networks were fragmented, with European roaming platforms raising in 2021 and 2022 (Monta, Bonnet). North American demand evidence at the time was not sourced.

identity.voice_and_tone: Infrastructure and partner announcements, plain technical tone

brand_strength.rationale: Mostly partner press releases; product name JustPlug is memorable but no brand press or community found.

outcome_analysis: Emobi is a YC W22 EV charging infrastructure company that built JustPlug Plug and Charge roaming and reports integration of over 122,000 chargers and pilots with large automakers. A reported $3.4M seed closed in January 2026, so it stayed small for years after the batch. It remains active with a growing partner list; no exit or shutdown was found.
notes: Company site returned 403. Seed confirmed by EV Engineering (2026-01-29) and Pulse 2.0, VC News Daily and others. TechCompanyNews claims about $1M earlier funding and over $4M total; unverified. Earlier pre-2026 rounds not found so coverage is partial. Competitors are from search results about European platforms; Bonnet source is about two months after batch start; no North American dated rival opened. No YC launch post found. Outcome search showed no layoffs, pivot or acquisition. Founded year not stated in sources opened.
